notes.title: This adorable platformer has you playing a Goomba-like minion fighting for freedom
notes.content: Mario presents a compelling caricature of a blue collar guy, sure, but who are the real working stiffs of the Mushroom Kingdom? That's right: the Goombas. Salt of the earth mushroom men walking back and forth on a platform day and night, all but turning to the camera and muttering "eh, it's a livin'!" They exist only to be trod upon by their betters. Goombas are the extras in a heated love triangle between an Italian, a turtle, and a neighboring monarch... Read more.

notes.title: Rog & Roll Adventure Demo Release!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38875356/2ecdfd0ef272766dfb03a27cef038dcbc7e113ce.png[/img]

Just in time for this year’s [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] - the [b]Rog & Roll Adventure Demo[/b] has been released!

[b]DEMO FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete the first world of the game!
[*] Play in [b]Adventure Mode[/b], which includes story cutscenes, a tutorial, an item shop, and an overworld to explore…
[*] Or stick with [b]Vintage Mode[/b], and play through levels in a more classic streamlined experience!
[*] Complete the demo to unlock a [b]Level Select[/b] mode (plus [b]2 BONUS LEVELS![/b])[/list]
[h3]Try it now for free on PC or Mac![/h3]
If you encounter any bugs or issues (or just want to share your impressions), please pass them along by selecting the [b]Feedback[/b] option either from the main menu or from the Pause menu during gameplay.

Thanks so much for playing! If you enjoy the demo, please consider [b]wishlisting[/b] the game - and keep an eye out for the full version, which should be rolling your way [b]very soon![/b]

notes.title: Rog & Roll Preview Demo!
notes.content:
For a limited time during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], you can preview a selection of levels from Rog & Roll! The selection includes breezy levels for platforming novices, challenging mid-game levels, and even a boss fight! See how fast you can clear levels, or challenge yourself to find all the secrets hidden in each stage. (Or do both! I mean, it's your copy of the demo, I can't tell you how to play it.)

If you don't know, Rog & Roll is a fast-paced, fluid 2.5D pixel art platformer with a unique perspective. Control a tiny enemy monster named Rog on a quest to save his fellow minions from the snare of their disgruntled ex-Final Boss!

If you're having trouble with the demo, [url=https://rogandroll.com/RogNRoll_PreviewDemo_Manual.pdf]there's a PDF instruction manual you can check out[/url]. (You can also check it out if you're not having trouble! There's some fun art in there, just saying.)

If you run into any bugs or have suggestions to improve the game, please reach out using the [b]Feedback[/b] menu - you can access it through the Level Select screen or the Pause Menu at any time.

Thanks so much for playing Rog & Roll! Hope you enjoy it.
